Jodhpur: Mob burns dumper after it crushes woman to death

In Jodhpur, a woman died after being hit by a speeding dumper truck. The incident occurred near the Jhalamand intersection as a group of devotees were returning from a pilgrimage. Following the accident, an enraged crowd beat the driver and set the dumper ablaze. The woman died at the scene.
